one_liner: Huggy, party-loving American cowgirl from Kentucky who speaks katakana-English and wants to make everyone happy.
personality: Taiki is bright, friendly and affectionate, always proposing hugs, barbecues and parties and calling everyone friends. She mixes English words into heavily katakana Japanese and plays up a cowgirl gunslinger image ('BANG!'). She hates being alone, gets homesick for her family in America, and slacks on schoolwork, but she sincerely wants to repay her trainer with happiness.

story_arc.summary: A sprinter-miler from America, Taiki races on both turf and dirt through the Shinzan Kinen, NHK Mile Cup, Unicorn Stakes, Yasuda Kinen, Sprinters Stakes and Mile CS, aiming at Horse of the Year. Her story explores a 'frontier spirit' and what lies beyond the mile, with a side chain about Silence Suzuka's awakening.
